qingdao-2016.notes: Source 1 is a login page. The HDU page is a re-run held 2016-11-19, not the contest day; no source states the contest date.

sources.evidence: The copy is a 109-character login page of the i上编程 site (HUSTOJ) with no contest content.
Table of 327 ranked team rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation, titled The 2016 ACM-ICPC Asia QingDao Regional Contest.
Problem list of 13 problems whose titles match the known problems A to M, headed as a re-run of the 2016 Qingdao contest.

qingdao-2017.notes: Source 2 says the on-site contest ran 4 to 5 November 2017 while the pack has 2017-11-05. Source 3 is titled as a CCPC Qingdao ranklist but its table carries the same top teams and results as source 4; it stops at 357 teams, source 4 lists 365. Source 1 was captured when the site had moved on to the 2018 edition. Source 5 counts 356 teams against 365 on source 4.

sources.evidence: WordPress site of the host's contest team whose posts include the 42nd regional's certificate list, media links, team photos and a link to the final board.
Home page titled The 2017 ACM-ICPC Asia QingDao Regional Contest with registration and rules posts, captured before the contest.
Table of 357 team rows with columns for school, rank, team, solved, time and problems A to K, titled as a CCPC Qingdao ranklist.
Table of 365 team rows with Rank1, Rank2, Solved, Penalty and cells A to K with times and failed attempts, last updated 2017-11-05.
Table of 356 ranked team rows with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Citation and no per-problem cells.
Luogu replay contest page whose embedded data lists 11 problems A to K with the titles of the 2017 Qingdao problem set.

qingdao-2018.notes: Source 2 holds only page 1 of 3 of the Codeforces board (200 of 479 rows).
